cases.question: How does successful Login work, and how is it tested?
cases.response: Successful password Login uses POST /token. LoginPage.login fills the credentials, returns HomePage, and the test in ui/specs/login.spec.ts asserts homePage.title is visible. The response is source-verified, but the Playwright test was not executed during this review.

cases.question: Which authentication endpoint does the Login UI use?
cases.response: The Login UI uses POST /token. The backend also exposes POST /auth/login as a separate endpoint, but it is not the endpoint used by the current UI flow. Any knowledge note claiming that the UI uses /auth/login is stale or conflicted.
